WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(ST_GeomFromText('MULTIPOLYGON (((-79.898033 41.009638, -79.893677 41.009289, -79.894647 41.002851, -79.899014 41.003219, -79.898033 41.009638)), ((-79.878952 40.956811, -79.880261 41.027928, -79.979954 41.026892, -79.977073 40.971744, -79.97622 40.955854, -79.878952 40.956811)))',4326)), 3) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
area_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(ST_Area(parks.geometry::geography)) AS area
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
    AND ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT g::geography FROM region))
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, buffered_region r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
),
slope_agg AS (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).mean AS slope
  FROM region_slope
)
SELECT a.area, s.slope
FROM area_sum a, slope_agg s;
